title: elegance: inconsistent re-export path for UserCredential across crates
description: reader/src/config.rs re-exports 'stoa_auth::UserCredential' (root path). imap/src/config.rs re-exports 'stoa_auth::config::UserCredential' (module path). imap/src/session/auth.rs also uses the module path directly. The same type has two different import paths in use across the workspace. One should be canonical. Since stoa_auth::lib.rs already re-exports UserCredential at the root (confirmed by auth/tests/integration.rs using it that way), the reader pattern is correct and imap/config.rs should match it. Suggested fix: change imap/config.rs to 'pub use stoa_auth::UserCredential' and align imap/session/auth.rs accordingly.
